question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram evidence, or should a maintainer explicitly override the real-behavior gate based on its deterministic dispatch and ledger coverage?
rationale: The code path and tests are convincing, but only a maintainer can accept the remaining external-system uncertainty or arrange credentialed Telegram proof.

options.title: Capture live Telegram proof

options.title: Explicitly accept deterministic proof
options.body: A maintainer may override the live-proof gate after reviewing the stubbed Bot API boundary and accepting the residual delivery and session-state risk.
